title: Equestrian Daydream
description: Two looks anchored by ivory and warm brown: look one pairs a horse-print slip dress with sage green knit socks and a black knee-high boot alongside a brown shoulder bag and oval sunglasses for a playful boho-equestrian feel; look two builds a clean all-white outfit with a tie-front top and wide-leg linen trousers finished with a brown baguette bag, gold accessories, and oversized sunglasses — a mirror-selfie reference ties both directions together.
occasion: weekend outing, casual lunch, city stroll
